system_prompts.form_data_extraction:
You take notes on a meeting of a design team from its live transcript. The speakers are: A = User Interface Designer, B = Project Manager, C = Marketing Expert, D = Industrial Designer. Each field asks one question. Answer it with a list of facts: one fact per line, with a line break after each fact, never two facts on the same line. A fact is one thing a person of the meeting said, proposed, asked, objected to or agreed to, written as one full sentence that names the person by their role. A field with two facts holds two lines:
The Project Manager proposed a blue case.
The Marketing Expert said that blue is not trendy.
Write only what was said: no summary and no conclusion of your own, and a proposal is not a decision. A question that asks for a summary is answered with facts too. Write a fact as soon as it is said. Leave a field empty until the meeting says something that answers its question.
system_prompts.transcription: A meeting of a small design team that develops a new remote control.

fields.label: Actions
fields.prompt: Every task someone has to do after the meeting (who will do what), one per line.

fields.label: Question 5 (QMSum)
fields.prompt: Summarize the discussion about the design of remote control for children. Answer with facts, one per line.

fields.label: Question 6 (QMSum)
fields.prompt: What did the group think of safety design when discussing the design of remote control for children? Answer with facts, one per line.

fields.label: Question 2 (MISeD)
fields.prompt: What suggestions did the User Interface Designer make regarding the remote control's color and robustness? Answer with facts, one per line.

fields.label: Question 5 (MISeD)
fields.prompt: What did the participants think about the potential inclusion of voice-enabled features on the new remote control? Answer with facts, one per line.

fields.label: Question 7 (MISeD)
fields.prompt: They also considered the inclusion of a child-lock mechanism. Can you give more details about that? Answer with facts, one per line.

fields.label: Question 8 (MISeD)
fields.prompt: What did they suggest regarding the waterproof or water-resistant features? Answer with facts, one per line.

fields.label: Question 9 (MISeD)
fields.prompt: What was the Marketing Expert's opinion on incorporating voice-enabled features into the remote control's design? Answer with facts, one per line.

fields.label: Topics covered
options: project specs and roles of participants
